name: Mass Point QEF Minimization
definition: A method to find the vertex position in Dual Contouring by minimizing the distance to a 'mass point' (the average of exact intersection points on cube edges) rather than the cube center, ensuring the solution lies inside the generating cube.
summary: Mass Point QEF Minimization is a vertex placement strategy that minimizes distance to the average of edge intersections, ensuring the dual vertex remains inside the generating cube.
